scope: Typed Entry Fabric causal event/admission identity, HCU router policy/engine/route identity, and downstream inference receipt identity

authority_source.law: The retained donor lane may implement or test the main-selected canonicalization path but may not supersede current main authority by selecting a competing encoder.

selection_basis: current canonical main explicitly adjudicated RFC8785_JCS_IJSON/v1 as the target Entry+HCU canonicalization path
the implementation already exists on the retained donor lane with bounded conformance evidence
RFC8785 provides a standardized cross-language JSON canonicalization target rather than creating a bespoke second product authority
historical CBOR, custom typed-binary and Python sort_keys identities remain reproducible only at their original versioned scope

current_implementation_split.law: Selection of RFC8785_JCS_IJSON/v1 does not retroactively reinterpret current or historical hashes. Until all active identity producers and consumers are explicitly migrated under new versioned identities and tested together, mixed-schema identity is not admitted for cross-language or runtime promotion.

alternative_candidate_adjudication.hcu_causal_canonical_v1.py: RESEARCH_PROVENANCE_ONLY_NOT_SELECTED_BY_CURRENT_MAIN; exact replication remains bounded mechanism evidence
alternative_candidate_adjudication.typed_entry_canonical_v1.py: LEGACY_CURRENT_SOURCE_DEPENDENCY_PENDING_MIGRATION; deterministic CBOR subset remains valid only for its original bounded source scope and must not be promoted as a second active causal identity authority

remaining_gates_before_source_promotion: wire RFC8785_JCS_IJSON/v1 into Typed Entry event and admission identity production under new versioned identities
wire the same selected schema into router policy, engine and route identity production
wire the same selected schema into downstream inference receipt hashing and echo checks
update focused tests to prove one schema version is present end to end and mixed, unknown or downgraded versions fail closed
retain raw JSON duplicate-name, nonfinite-number and lone-surrogate rejection before ordinary Mapping construction
wire HCU_REACTIVE_EVENT/v1 into GRID10 mode selection and plan compilation while preserving external Entry budget and runtime-capacity authority
run exact-current combined Entry+router+inference+canonicalization+GRID10 regressions on an actually-started authorized isolated executor
rebase and fuse the settled retained mechanisms onto current main without duplicate authority
bind real admitted local checkpoint, tokenizer, runtime/build bytes, capability record and measured capacity receipt before physical model promotion
rebuild the compatibility package only after source identity semantics settle

bounded_discriminator.observation: A donor-selected ENTITYOS_HCU_TYPED_CANONICAL/v1 conflicts with canonical main selection RFC8785_JCS_IJSON/v1 and must fail closed as CANONICALIZATION_AUTHORITY_DRIFT.
bounded_discriminator.counterfactual_after_reentry: Donor contract selecting RFC8785_JCS_IJSON/v1 matches main authority and removes the split-selection condition.

note: This re-enters the retained donor lane under current main authority without creating a second state, routing, truth, permission, recovery or effect authority. The selected RFC8785 path is still not end-to-end wired or runtime accepted.
